Glorious things of thee are spoken
Glorious things of thee are spoken,
He, whose word cannot be broken,
Formed thee for his own abode:
On the rock of ages founded,
What can shake thy sure repose?
Thou may’st smile at all thy foes.
The passage it draws on most

Its book prints no verse above this hymn. Of the verses its lines share most wording with, this is the one the whole hymn draws on, chosen by an AI model from those the word matching found. Not the author's own heading.
Glorious things are ascribed to you, O city of God. Selah PSALM 87:3 · BEREAN STANDARD BIBLE OPEN IT BESIDE THE PAGE
Book I of Olney Hymns walks through the Bible from Genesis to Revelation, one hymn per passage: 141 hymns. This is number 60. Point at a tick to see the hymn; click it to open that hymn.
